_doc: Docking for repair in the main docking bay (M8-T06, D82). Lengths in metres, speeds in m/s, times in seconds; boxes in the station's frame (the bay's axis runs along +z into the drum; the drum, its pivot 1000 m forward of the station's middle, reaches from z -3576 to 1500 with the mouth at -3519.6, its ring and pylon inside the drum's box). dock_range_m: a fighter docks only at its own home dock (Combatant.home: the scenario's `home`, or the station whose Cobra bays launched it), and only while that dock's bay is within this range of it; farther out, with no home or with its home gone, it stays and fights and the wing's DOCK order is not offered. 60 km covers the station's own space out to its jumpgate. The player's docking shots are in docking_shots.json (M8-T31).
